title: WiFiSenseFeatureSchemaV1
description: Flat feature vector schema for a windowed CSI signal segment

timestamp_start.description: UTC start timestamp of the CSI window in seconds

timestamp_end.description: UTC end timestamp of the CSI window in seconds

energy_sc_[0-63].description: Signal energy (sum of squares) for subcarrier j

entropy_sc_[0-63].description: Shannon entropy of amplitude histogram for subcarrier j

peaks_sc_[0-63].description: Number of local peaks detected in the time series for subcarrier j

dom_freq_sc_[0-63].description: Dominant frequency (Hz) excluding the DC offset for subcarrier j

centroid_sc_[0-63].description: Spectral centroid (Hz) from FFT for subcarrier j

low_ratio_sc_[0-63].description: Ratio of energy in low-band (0-2.5 Hz) to total energy for subcarrier j

med_ratio_sc_[0-63].description: Ratio of energy in mid-band (2.5-10 Hz) to total energy for subcarrier j

high_ratio_sc_[0-63].description: Ratio of energy in high-band (10+ Hz) to total energy for subcarrier j

diff_mean_sc_[0-63].description: Mean of absolute first differences (velocity/rate of change) for subcarrier j

diff_std_sc_[0-63].description: Standard deviation of absolute first differences for subcarrier j

autocorr_sc_[0-63].description: Autocorrelation coefficient with lag-1 for subcarrier j

agg_mean.description: Average mean value across all subcarriers

agg_variance.description: Average variance value across all subcarriers

agg_std.description: Average standard deviation across all subcarriers

agg_entropy.description: Average Shannon entropy across all subcarriers

agg_peaks.description: Average number of local peaks across all subcarriers

agg_dom_freq.description: Average dominant frequency across all subcarriers

agg_centroid.description: Average spectral centroid across all subcarriers

agg_low_ratio.description: Average low-frequency energy ratio across all subcarriers

agg_med_ratio.description: Average mid-frequency energy ratio across all subcarriers

agg_high_ratio.description: Average high-frequency energy ratio across all subcarriers

agg_diff_mean.description: Average rate of change mean across all subcarriers

agg_diff_std.description: Average rate of change standard deviation across all subcarriers

agg_autocorr.description: Average lag-1 autocorrelation across all subcarriers
